name: Early humans
desc: Fire, foraging and stories. Bands live in tents and lean-tos.

name: Stone Age
desc: Knapped flint and ground stone. Huts, farms and the first boats.

name: Bronze Age
desc: Copper and tin become bronze. Rulers, walls, temples and writing.

name: Classical age
desc: Iron, coins, written law and philosophy. Cities with temples, theatres and aqueducts.

name: Age of Sail
desc: Ocean ships, compasses and cannon. The edge of the map is only the beginning.
